scope.target: the 49 R7B cases whose candidate terminal was OPEN
scope.selection_rule: rerun frozen R7B candidate on the same 72 frozen cases and select candidate.terminal == OPEN before any R7C shadow truth query

hypothesis: After exact meet, some GENERAL_CNF central kernels can be resolved by additional exact polynomial closures and recognizable tractable classes, then diverged outward to a replayable certificate without any R6-quarantined search.
frozen_candidate_pipeline: opposite deterministic unit convergence to identical canonical kernel
polynomial pure-literal closure with reconstruction trace
polynomial failed-literal closure using only one-level assumptions plus unit propagation; no recursive lookahead
renamable-Horn recognition by a 2SAT renaming constraint system, then Horn solving
exact bipartite-matching-CNF recognition and augmenting-path matching
outward witness reconstruction and direct CNF replay

polynomiality_firewall.failed_literal_rule: At most |V| successful forces. Between forces, at most one deterministic sweep over remaining variables; each assumption performs only unit closure. No assumption recursively invokes failed-literal testing.
polynomiality_firewall.renamable_horn: Build O(sum clause_length^2) 2SAT constraints over flip variables, solve by SCC, transform once, solve Horn once.
polynomiality_firewall.matching_cnf: Syntactic recognition plus bipartite augmenting-path matching; no subset enumeration and no Hall-set search.

success_interpretation: A pass only establishes scoped recovery on previously exposed R7B OPEN kernels. It does not establish arbitrary-CNF totality, a global polynomial SAT solver, or P=NP.
failure_interpretation: A failure is retained. No rule, class, threshold, or target case may be changed after execution to recolor the run.
